title: Ski Trip
description:
What better way to celebrate the end of Semester 1 than a trip down south? Come along with us to Mt Ruapehu for a few days of skiing/snowboarding, side quests on the mountain scene and making memorable moments! 🏔️😻

Whether you're hitting the slopes properly or spending half the time falling over 😵‍💫 this trip's all about making the most of the snow season ❄️ Get ready for good vibes, fun nights at the lodge, and memories you'll probably still be talking about next sem 😆

‼️ Price does NOT include ski/snowboard rental at Mt Ruapehu ‼️

⚠️ PLEASE NOTE: Your spot will not be confirmed immediately after signing up. Confirmation emails and deposit information will be sent out after registration.
